Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The agent pivoted to retrieving YouTube captions to find an on-screen visual phrase, misinterpreting that such graphics would appear in captions. This decision entered an unproductive loop (tool installation and caption fetching) that did not address the actual data source needed and diverted effort from viable text-based sources. Although not strictly irrecoverable, it was the first misaligned decision that set the process on a path that failed to produce the phrase.
